signals.headline: Founder (71) confirms a structured succession review is under way
signals.detail: In a published regional business interview the founder said the family has started a structured process to decide between family succession and bringing in an external partner, with a decision targeted within twelve months. The second-generation managing director separately confirmed that an advisory mandate is being scoped.

signals.headline: CFO mandate extended to cover corporate development
signals.detail: The chief financial officer's remit was formally widened to include corporate development and transaction preparation, a pattern often seen ahead of a process.

signals.headline: New CFO hired from a private-equity backed dental platform
signals.detail: Nils Aebischer joined as chief financial officer from a private equity majority-owned dental platform. A capability hire consistent with institutional preparation, but no ownership change or process has been reported.

signals.headline: Two outlets report an unsolicited approach for a minority stake
signals.detail: Reports of an unsolicited approach for a 25 to 30 percent minority stake. The family declined to comment and no adviser appointment has been confirmed.

signals.headline: Founder stepped back to chair, daughter appointed chief executive
signals.detail: Completed generational transition announced in November 2025. This signal is retained for the record and is the trigger on which the company was promoted to the active pipeline at the time.

signals.headline: Unverified report of a shareholder agreement revision
signals.detail: A single trade publication referred to a revised shareholder agreement among family members. The report is vague on substance and no filing has been observed.
corroborating_sources: Secondary aggregator repeating the same report (mock)

signals.headline: Single-source report that a sale process is being prepared
signals.detail: One outlet reported that advisers are being lined up for a sale process. No second source and no confirmation from the company or any adviser.

signals.headline: Founder chairman (68) to retire from the board at the next annual meeting
signals.detail: Confirmed board retirement of the founder chairman. Retained in the universe to demonstrate that a strong confirmed trigger on a structurally excluded company must not generate a promotion.

signals.headline: New chief financial officer appointed from a listed care operator
signals.detail: Priya Raman joined as chief financial officer from a listed care home operator. A single professionalisation hire with no accompanying ownership or process signal.

signals.headline: Advisory board expanded with two external members
signals.detail: Two independent members joined the advisory board. Weak evidence of institutionalisation; no change to the shareholder register.

signals.headline: Family holding vehicle restructured ahead of a generational transfer
signals.detail: Confirmed restructuring of the family holding vehicle. Retained to demonstrate that a strong confirmed trigger on a listed company must not generate a promotion.
